challenge.better_approach: Delete every proof's own sys.path insert and rely on the tester's PYTHONPATH pin: smaller, but a proof run directly (python3 <proof>, or under cairn test --exec, which passes the raw env) would then fall through for all 657, and 31 already do. Fixing the six and sieving the shape is the narrower move.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a static evaluation of Path(__file__) expressions reaches the inserts that matter: measured, it resolves all six the grep census found and no false hit; walks and computed loops are left unjudged, not passed.
challenge.prior_art: The tester's _env_pinned_to (ticket fc93d8cd5961) pins the checkout for subject runs, and is why the short root is masked under bin/cairn test; proof_coverage's call-time-binding sieve (c5b6b128a376) is the pattern this sieve follows. Neither reads a proof's own root.
challenge.real_collision: None: tester is untouched (cc_0 holds it); the sieve lives in proof_coverage, which PROVEME already reads.

answers.falsifier: RED if a proof whose only sys.path root is <repo>/cairn passes proof_coverage, or if a proof that roots at the checkout, or only names a root inside a fixture string, is flagged.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator relayed it from a measured hollow green: 0d3b8a51c9df's proof at 1bfc8f29f put parents[5] on sys.path; see cairn/devices/codemother/machines/outline_check/proofs/test_an_open_question_opens_only_on_a_line_the_ticket_touches.py
answers.how: Add an AST sieve to proof_coverage that evaluates each sys.path insert/append of a Path(__file__) expression and lacks a proof that imports cairn and roots nowhere at the checkout; wire it into lacks(); fix the six proofs it finds at HEAD (parents one short); red first on the 1bfc8f29f outline_check proof.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: a short root reads main's code through the editable install, so a hollow cannot red it) and Law 4 (the rule becomes a sieve, not a convention).
answers.what: Every proof puts its own checkout root on sys.path, and proof_coverage reds at PROVEME a proof whose computed sys.path root is inside the repo but not the repo root.

bullets.text: Under the tester a short sys.path root is masked by _env_pinned_to; run directly, 0d3b's parents[5] proof printed 3/3 green over the old code off main's editable install. Six more proofs carried the same short root.
31 of 657 proofs import cairn and put nothing on sys.path; they fall through the same way when run outside the tester. Not this ticket's scope; recorded.
